descriptions.en: Metamodel for describing systems with a subset of ArchiMate (L0–L4). Not part of knowledge-core.
descriptions.cs: Metamodel pro popis systémů podmnožinou ArchiMate (L0–L4). Není součástí jádra knowledge-core.

descriptions.en: Global typing property. Created only when GET /v1/admin/schema-config has empty instanceOfProperty. Not ArchiMate-specific.

instanceOf.usageGuidance: Global typing property linking an entity to its class. Created only when schema-config instanceOfProperty is empty; not ArchiMate-specific.
instanceOf.usageExamples: entity CRM typed as ApplicationComponent; AllowedRelationship row typed as AllowedRelationship.

descriptions.en: Not an ArchiMate concept. Root for tool policy data stored in this package (allowed pairs, enums, exchange notes).

classes.usageGuidance: Root for Lite tool-policy data stored in this package (allowed pairs, enums, exchange notes). Not used in architecture diagrams.
classes.usageExamples: AllowedRelationship rows; StringEnum instances; the single ExchangeSpec entity.

descriptions.en: Lite matrix row: relationship class + source class + target class. Enforced by tools, not by KC.

classes.usageGuidance: Declares one allowed (relationship type, source class, target class) triple for tool-side matrix checks. KC does not enforce it.
classes.usageExamples: Assignment BusinessActor→BusinessRole; Serving TechnologyService→ApplicationComponent; DeployedOn ApplicationComponent→SystemSoftware.

descriptions.en: Allowed string values for a property. Enforced by tools, not by KC.

classes.usageGuidance: Lists allowed string values for a named property. Tools validate against these instances; KC does not.
classes.usageExamples: enum/modelingDepth with catalog|dr_minimum|…; enum/accessMode with read|write|readWrite.

descriptions.en: Open Exchange mapping notes for tools. Single instance iriLocal=exchange-spec.

classes.usageGuidance: Holds Open Exchange mapping notes for importers/exporters. Prefer a single instance with iriLocal=exchange-spec.
classes.usageExamples: exchange-spec with catalogVersion, exchangeFormat, and DeployedOn/Risk/views rules.

classes.usageGuidance: Abstract root of all ArchiMate Lite concepts (elements, relationships, views). Do not instantiate directly.
classes.usageExamples: Prefer a concrete subclass such as ApplicationComponent or Serving.

classes.usageGuidance: Abstract parent of structural/behavioral architecture elements. Instances are typed via instanceOf to a concrete subclass.
classes.usageExamples: BusinessService, ApplicationComponent, Node, Risk — never ArchiMateElement itself.

classes.usageGuidance: Abstract parent of relationship entities. Each relationship is its own entity with relSource and relTarget.
classes.usageExamples: Serving, Access, Flow, DeployedOn — create a relationship entity, not a free-form link.

classes.usageGuidance: Abstract parent of diagram/view constructs used to present the model.
classes.usageExamples: DiagramView, ViewNode, ViewConnection.

classes.usageGuidance: An organizational entity capable of performing behavior — the owner, unit, or external party accountable for a system or service.
classes.usageExamples: Business unit owning CRM; external payment provider; operations department; customer organization.

classes.usageGuidance: A responsibility that an actor may assume. Use for ownership and operating roles, not for technical accounts.
classes.usageExamples: Business owner; system owner; on-call operator; compliance officer.

classes.usageGuidance: An externally visible unit of business behavior offered to customers or the organization.
classes.usageExamples: Customer onboarding; invoice issuance; employee self-service; payment acceptance.

classes.usageGuidance: A sequence of business behaviors achieving a specific outcome. Use for key processes the system supports.
classes.usageExamples: Order-to-cash; claim handling; identity provisioning request; month-end close.

classes.usageGuidance: A modular, deployable application building block. At L0 model the whole system; at L2 split into frontend, backend, workers, etc.
classes.usageExamples: CRM as a whole; web frontend; API backend; batch worker; shared microservice.

classes.usageGuidance: Application behavior exposed to the environment (users or other systems).
classes.usageExamples: CreateCustomer service; SearchOrders; Authentication API capability; Reporting service.

classes.usageGuidance: A point of access where application services are made available to users or other applications.
classes.usageExamples: REST /v1/customers; customer web UI; Kafka topic OrdersIn; SOAP gateway.

classes.usageGuidance: Automated behavior internal to an application component. Prefer when modeling internal capability, not a full workflow.
classes.usageExamples: ValidateOrder; CalculateTax; HashPassword; IndexDocument.

classes.usageGuidance: An application-level workflow or batch sequence spanning one or more functions.
classes.usageExamples: Nightly settlement batch; document OCR pipeline; password-reset flow.

classes.usageGuidance: An application-level state change of interest for integration or operations.
classes.usageExamples: OrderCreated; PaymentFailed; UserLockedOut; CertificateExpiring.

classes.usageGuidance: A temporary or logical aggregation of application components cooperating as one unit.
classes.usageExamples: Checkout collaboration (cart + payment + inventory); login collaboration (UI + IdP adapter).

classes.usageGuidance: A passive structure of data meaningful to the architecture (not every table or cache entry).
classes.usageExamples: Customer master; order transactions; audit log; configuration store; search index.

classes.usageGuidance: A technology capability used by applications — databases, identity, DNS, storage, messaging, load balancing.
classes.usageExamples: PostgreSQL database service; Keycloak/IdP; corporate DNS; object storage; Kafka cluster service.

classes.usageGuidance: An access point to a technology service that is architecturally significant (stable endpoints, VIPs).
classes.usageExamples: DB listener host:5432; ingress VIP; Kubernetes API endpoint; DNS resolver address.

classes.usageGuidance: A computational resource on which artifacts and system software are deployed (logical or virtual).
classes.usageExamples: Application VM; Kubernetes worker node; bastion host; managed DB instance endpoint node.

classes.usageGuidance: A physical ICT resource. Use when the physical appliance matters for DR, network, or ownership.
classes.usageExamples: Physical server; firewall appliance; hardware load balancer; storage array controller.

classes.usageGuidance: Software environment that hosts or runs application artifacts (OS, platform, middleware, DB engine).
classes.usageExamples: RHEL; Kubernetes; PostgreSQL engine; JVM runtime; message broker runtime.

classes.usageGuidance: A physical piece of data used or produced in deployment — images, packages, charts, config bundles.
classes.usageExamples: Container image; Helm chart; Terraform module; signed config package; WAR/JAR release.

classes.usageGuidance: A communication medium or logical network segment relevant to security/DR (VLAN, subnet, WAN, DMZ).
classes.usageExamples: APP_NET VLAN; DB_NET; DMZ; DC interconnect WAN; backup network.

classes.usageGuidance: A logical or physical communication path between nodes or networks that is worth naming for impact analysis.
classes.usageExamples: DC1↔DC2 replication path; primary site to DR site WAN path; app tier to DB tier path.

classes.usageGuidance: A physical structure or environment such as a datacenter or technical building.
classes.usageExamples: DC1 Prague; colo facility; head-office server room.

classes.usageGuidance: A geographic or organizational place. Use when site matters for DR, latency, or regulation.
classes.usageExamples: Prague; Brno DR site; EU-central region; branch office.

classes.usageGuidance: A statement of need that must be realized by the architecture (availability, RTO/RPO, compliance).
classes.usageExamples: RTO ≤ 4h; RPO ≤ 15m; 99.9% availability; GDPR retention constraint.

classes.usageGuidance: Result of an analysis used to motivate decisions (criticality, maturity, health).
classes.usageExamples: Business criticality = high; architecture fitness review; dependency risk score.

classes.usageGuidance: A risk relevant to the architecture (Risk and Security overlay). Prefer for known SPOFs and threat outcomes.
classes.usageExamples: Single WAN link between DCs; sole IdP without standby; unencrypted backup channel.

classes.usageGuidance: Difference between baseline and target architecture that a change initiative must close.
classes.usageExamples: Missing HA for payment DB; no DR runbook for IdP; absent network segmentation.

classes.usageGuidance: A series of actions designed to achieve a goal within a defined timeframe.
classes.usageExamples: CRM migration wave 1; network zoning project; HA database rollout.

classes.usageGuidance: Whole–part where the part has the same lifetime as the whole (strong ownership).
classes.usageExamples: CRM system composed of Frontend+Backend+Worker; Node composed of Devices.

classes.usageGuidance: Whole–part grouping without shared lifetime (loose collection).
classes.usageExamples: ApplicationCollaboration aggregating components; cluster aggregating nodes.

classes.usageGuidance: Allocation of responsibility or deployment: actor→role, role→service, software→node, artifact→node.
classes.usageExamples: BusinessActor→BusinessRole; SystemSoftware→Node; Artifact→Node.

classes.usageGuidance: More concrete element realizes a more abstract one (component realizes service/requirement).
classes.usageExamples: ApplicationComponent→BusinessService; ApplicationComponent→ApplicationService; Device→TechnologyService.

classes.usageGuidance: Provider serves a consumer with behavior or capability. Preferred over Used-By for Lite models.
classes.usageExamples: ApplicationService→BusinessProcess; TechnologyService→ApplicationComponent; Device→CommunicationNetwork.

classes.usageGuidance: Behavioral element accesses a data object. Set accessMode to read, write, or readWrite.
classes.usageExamples: Backend→CustomerData (readWrite); Worker→AuditLog (write); Reporting→Orders (read).

classes.usageGuidance: Transfer of information, value, or goods between elements. Attach protocol/port/zone attributes when relevant (L2–L4).
classes.usageExamples: Backend→ExternalPayment (HTTPS); Backend→Worker (Kafka); App tier→DB tier (TCP/5432 cross-zone).

classes.usageGuidance: Temporal or causal triggering: source triggers target behavior.
classes.usageExamples: ApplicationEvent→ApplicationProcess; Process A triggers Process B; schedule triggers batch.

classes.usageGuidance: Generalization/specialization between elements of the same kind.
classes.usageExamples: Generic ApplicationComponent specialized as PaymentGatewayComponent.

classes.usageGuidance: Undirected structural link when no more specific relationship fits. Prefer specific types when possible.
classes.usageExamples: Requirement↔ApplicationComponent; Node↔Facility; Facility↔Location; Node↔CommunicationNetwork.

classes.usageGuidance: Motivation influence: how an assessment or risk affects a requirement or service.
classes.usageExamples: Assessment→Requirement; Risk→BusinessService.

descriptions.en: Lite convenience. Exchange tools expand to Assignment (component→system software→node, artifact→node).

classes.usageGuidance: Lite convenience for deployment. Exchange tools expand to Assignment (e.g. component→system software→node, artifact→node).
classes.usageExamples: ApplicationComponent→SystemSoftware; Artifact→Node.

classes.usageGuidance: A named diagram/viewpoint over the model. Use viewpoint to distinguish catalog, dependencies, application, technology, network.
classes.usageExamples: sys-crm catalog view; landscape dependency view; network zone view.

classes.usageGuidance: A visual node in a diagram, usually referencing an ArchiMate element via elementRef.
classes.usageExamples: Box for ApplicationComponent; container group; free-text label node.

classes.usageGuidance: A visual edge in a diagram referencing a relationship entity and its source/target view nodes.
classes.usageExamples: Line for Serving between two ViewNodes; Flow edge with bendpoints.

descriptions.en: Relationship source element (instance of ArchiMateElement or subclass).

properties.usageGuidance: Marks the source element of a relationship entity. Required on every ArchiMateRelationship instance.
properties.usageExamples: Serving where source is TechnologyService PostgreSQL; Access where source is Backend component.

descriptions.en: Relationship target element (instance of ArchiMateElement or subclass).

properties.usageGuidance: Marks the target element of a relationship entity. Required on every ArchiMateRelationship instance.
properties.usageExamples: Serving targeting ApplicationComponent CRM; Access targeting DataObject CustomerMaster.

descriptions.en: catalog | dr_minimum | application_detail | infrastructure_detail | network_detail

properties.usageGuidance: Declares modeling granularity for an element (L0–L4 style). Prefer on every ArchiMateElement; shape aml-element warns if missing.
properties.usageExamples: catalog for L0 system card; dr_minimum for L1 dependencies; application_detail; infrastructure_detail; network_detail.

properties.usageGuidance: Lifecycle status of the element in the estate (planned, live, retiring, etc.).
URI pointing to an authoritative external record (CMDB, ticket, docs).
Which system is authoritative for this element's facts.
properties.usageExamples: ServiceNow CMDB; Terraform state; DNS IPAM; manual architecture register.

properties.usageGuidance: Business or organizational owner accountable for the element.
properties.usageExamples: Retail Operations; Head of Payments; Business unit XYZ.

properties.usageGuidance: Technical team or role responsible for running/changing the element.
properties.usageExamples: Platform team; CRM guild; DBAs; Network ops.

properties.usageGuidance: Business criticality classification used for DR and prioritization.
Recovery Time Objective for the element or system.
Recovery Point Objective — acceptable data loss window.
Qualifies the kind of dependency expressed by a relationship.

descriptions.en: mandatory | optional

properties.usageGuidance: Whether the dependency is mandatory or optional for degraded operation.
What limited operation remains if the dependency fails.
properties.usageExamples: read-only catalog; queue and retry; manual workaround; full outage.

properties.usageGuidance: Business consequence of failure of the dependency or element.
properties.usageExamples: Cannot accept orders; delayed invoicing; login unavailable.

properties.usageGuidance: Communication protocol on interfaces, flows, or related concepts.
TCP/UDP port that is architecturally significant.
Whether an interaction is synchronous (blocking) or asynchronous.
properties.usageExamples: true for REST request/response; false for queue/event publish.

properties.usageGuidance: Authentication mechanism expected at an interface or flow.
properties.usageExamples: OIDC; mTLS; API key; Kerberos; none (internal only).

properties.usageGuidance: Timeout policy relevant to resilience analysis.
Retry/backoff expectations for a dependency.
properties.usageExamples: 3 retries exponential backoff; no retry; at-least-once with DLQ.

properties.usageGuidance: Name of the message, event, or payload exchanged.

descriptions.en: read | write | readWrite

properties.usageGuidance: How a behavioral element accesses a DataObject (Access relationships).
Business/technical classification of a DataObject.
System of record that masters this data object.
properties.usageExamples: CRM; ERP; IdP; locally owned by this system.

properties.usageGuidance: Retention period or policy for the data.
properties.usageExamples: 7 years; 90 days; GDPR erasure on request.

properties.usageGuidance: Whether the data can be rebuilt from upstream sources after loss.
properties.usageExamples: true for derived search index; false for irreplaceable audit originals.

properties.usageGuidance: Whether backups are required for this data object.
properties.usageExamples: true for customer master; false for ephemeral cache.

properties.usageGuidance: Information security classification of the data.
Runtime environment name for deployed elements.
Cluster or platform grouping where the element runs.
Logical namespace within a platform (e.g. Kubernetes).
Runtime technology hosting the component.
Configured replica/instance count for capacity and HA reasoning.
High-availability pattern in use.
Primary operating site for the element.
Disaster-recovery site for the element.
Where deployment artifacts/config come from.
properties.usageExamples: GitOps repo; CI pipeline; Helm chart registry; manual.

properties.usageGuidance: VLAN identifier for a CommunicationNetwork.
CIDR block of a CommunicationNetwork.
Security or network zone label.
Site affiliation for network or deployment concepts.
Routing domain or VRF name for a network.
Fully qualified domain name of a significant technology interface.
Virtual IP of a load-balanced or floating endpoint.
Significant stable IP address (not every ephemeral node IP).
Reference to TLS certificate material for an interface.
properties.usageExamples: vault:secret/certs/crm-api; ACM arn:…; internal PKI serial.

properties.usageGuidance: Source security/network zone on a Flow.
Target security/network zone on a Flow.
Direction of a Flow relative to a trust boundary.
Reference to the firewall/security policy governing a Flow.

descriptions.en: catalog | dependencies | application | technology | network

properties.usageGuidance: Viewpoint of a DiagramView — which concern the diagram serves.
Links a ViewNode to the ArchiMateElement it represents.
properties.usageExamples: ViewNode box → ApplicationComponent CRM; ViewNode → CommunicationNetwork APP_NET.

descriptions.en: element | container | label

properties.usageGuidance: Kind of visual node in a diagram.
X coordinate of a ViewNode bounding box.
Y coordinate of a ViewNode bounding box.
Width of a ViewNode bounding box.
Height of a ViewNode bounding box.
JSON-encoded visual style for a view concept (tool-specific).
Parent ViewNode when nesting containers in a diagram.
properties.usageExamples: Worker node parented under System container node.

properties.usageGuidance: Links a ViewConnection to the ArchiMateRelationship it visualizes. Required.
properties.usageExamples: ViewConnection → Serving entity between API and IdP.

properties.usageGuidance: Source ViewNode of a ViewConnection. Required.
properties.usageExamples: ViewNode for Backend as source of a Flow edge.

properties.usageGuidance: Target ViewNode of a ViewConnection. Required.
properties.usageExamples: ViewNode for Database as target of a Flow edge.

properties.usageGuidance: JSON-encoded bend points for a ViewConnection path.

descriptions.en: Annotation on a class entity: business | application | technology | physical | composite | motivation | implementation.

properties.usageGuidance: Annotation on an element class entity stating its ArchiMate layer. Written by catalog load/import, not on model instances.
properties.usageExamples: business on BusinessActor; application on DataObject; technology on Node; motivation on Requirement.

descriptions.en: Annotation on a class entity, e.g. risk-and-security.

properties.usageGuidance: Annotation on a class entity for ArchiMate overlays (e.g. risk-and-security).

descriptions.en: Annotation on a relationship class. Absent means not a standard Open Exchange relationship type (e.g. DeployedOn).

properties.usageGuidance: Annotation on a relationship class with the Open Exchange xsi:type. Absent means non-standard (e.g. DeployedOn).
properties.usageExamples: Serving; Access; Assignment — omitted on DeployedOn.

descriptions.en: Annotation on a class or property entity explaining when and how to use that metamodel member.
descriptions.cs: Anotace na třídě nebo property vysvětlující, kdy a jak prvek metamodelu použít.

properties.usageGuidance: Metamodel annotation property. Attach as a statement on class or property entities; do not set on ordinary architecture instances.
properties.usageExamples: usageGuidance on ApplicationComponent; usageGuidance on modelingDepth.

descriptions.en: Annotation on a class or property entity with concrete usage examples.
descriptions.cs: Anotace na třídě nebo property s konkrétními příklady použití.

properties.usageGuidance: Metamodel annotation property listing examples. Attach as a statement on class or property entities.
properties.usageExamples: usageExamples on Serving; usageExamples on relSource.

properties.usageGuidance: On an AllowedRelationship instance: the relationship class that is permitted.
properties.usageExamples: Reference to Serving; Access; DeployedOn class IRI.

properties.usageGuidance: On an AllowedRelationship instance: permitted source element class.
On an AllowedRelationship instance: permitted target element class.

descriptions.en: The property whose string values this enum constrains (tool-side).

properties.usageGuidance: On a StringEnum instance: which property the allowed values constrain (tool-side).
properties.usageExamples: Reference to modelingDepth; accessMode; viewpoint property IRI.

properties.usageGuidance: One allowed string value for the enumerated property. Repeat for each value.
Version string of the ArchiMate Lite catalog carried on ExchangeSpec.
Human-readable Open Exchange format note for tools.
properties.usageExamples: ArchiMate Model Exchange File Format 3.1/3.2 XML.

properties.usageGuidance: Rule for mapping element classes to Exchange xsi:type.
Rule for mapping relationship classes to Exchange xsi:type.
properties.usageExamples: class iriLocal when exchangeType is set.

properties.usageGuidance: How DeployedOn should be expanded on Exchange export.
How Risk should be represented in Exchange.
properties.usageExamples: Risk and Security overlay type, or Assessment plus property overlay=Risk.

properties.usageGuidance: How view concepts map to Exchange view structures.
How instance identifiers are chosen for Exchange.
properties.usageExamples: iriLocal of instance, else entity_iri_alias kind imported, else public id.

exchange.format: ArchiMate Model Exchange File Format 3.1/3.2 XML
exchange.relationshipXsiType: class iriLocal when exchangeType is set
exchange.risk: Risk and Security overlay type, or Assessment plus property overlay=Risk
exchange.identifier: iriLocal of instance, else entity_iri_alias kind imported, else public id
